lines.text_raw: Preventative maintenance for SAMSUNG refrigerator (fridge or freezer) with a trapped grid compressor. This maintenance should be carried out once a year to avoid blockages in and outside the ventilation grids for the refrigerator to function properly.
lines.text_rendered: Preventative maintenance for SAMSUNG refrigerator (fridge or freezer) with a trapped grid compressor. This maintenance should be carried out once a year to avoid blockages in and outside the ventilation grids for the refrigerator to function properly.

lines.text_raw: Remove the fridge from its space, in this case it is installed between the left wall and a piece of furniture on the right.

lines.text_raw: Unplug the fridge to not cause accidents, remember that a refrigerator cannot be plugged in again until 5-10 minutes has passed since the compressor can still be hot and not start again.

lines.text_raw: With a vacuum and brush, proceed to clean the air vent.

lines.text_raw: ***Part 2 of Cleaning : Condensate Tray***
lines.text_rendered: Part 2 of Cleaning : Condensate Tray

lines.text_raw: This is the well-known tray where the tube from the back wall of the fridge carries the water produced by the defrosting process it operates every few hours to prevent ice buildup.
lines.text_rendered: This is the well-known tray where the tube from the back wall of the fridge carries the water produced by the defrosting process it operates every few hours to prevent ice buildup.

lines.text_raw: The tray collects a small amount of water which evaporates with the compressor's own heat; it is normal that it is never completely dry. Generally, a sticky residue will build up that should be cleaned from time to time.
